photos.description: Exposed foundations on the Münsterstraße (View from the Nonnengasse) in Dülmen , North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany The foundations date back to Dülmen’s pre-World War II development (the Duke of Croÿ’s administrative building (Rentei) in the foreground, and Agnetenberg Abbey in the background); the former KiK/Woolworth building was demolished at this site in 2016.
